meta.title: Account — outegro
meta.description: Sign in to outegro.dev apps and manage your account.

login.eyebrow: One account for every outegro.dev app
login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Enter your email and we will send a six-digit code. New here? The same step creates your account.
login.deliveryFailed: We could not send the email right now. Try again in a minute.

errors.invalid_code: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.

authorize.title: This link is not valid
authorize.body: The app that sent you here is not registered or used a wrong return address. Go back and try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.lead: How you appear across outegro.dev apps.
profile.conflict: The profile changed in another tab. Reload to see the latest version.
profile.invalid: Check the fields and try again.
profile.unavailable: Could not save right now. Try again shortly.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.lead: Devices and apps signed in to your account. Signing out here takes effect immediately.
sessions.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other sessions
sessions.revokedOthers: Signed out of {count, plural, =0 {no other sessions} one {# session} other {# sessions}}.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.unread: {count, plural, =0 {All read} one {# unread} other {# unread}}

preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.lead: Choose where each kind of message reaches you. Required channels cannot be switched off.
preferences.telegramHint: Telegram messages start once you link the bot (coming soon).
preferences.conflict: Settings changed in another tab. Reload to see the latest version.
preferences.invalid: Some of these settings cannot be changed.
preferences.unavailable: Could not save right now. Try again shortly.

errors.title: Something is temporarily unavailable
errors.body: Your data is safe. The service did not answer in time.
